SELECT TOP 50 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS n_patients FROM omop.procedure_occurrence p JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = p.procedure_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%helicobacter%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%h. pylori%' OR LOWER(p.procedure_source_value) LIKE '%helicobacter%' OR LOWER(p.procedure_source_value) LIKE '%h pylori%' OR LOWER(p.procedure_source_value) LIKE '%h. pylori%' GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code ORDER BY n_orders DESC

SELECT TOP 50 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.person_id) AS n_patients FROM omop.observation o JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = o.observation_concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%helicobacter%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%h. pylori%' OR LOWER(o.observation_source_value) LIKE '%helicobacter%' OR LOWER(o.observation_source_value) LIKE '%h pylori%' OR LOWER(o.observation_source_value) LIKE '%h. pylori%' GROUP BY c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_code ORDER BY n_orders DESC
